notes.title: Update 1.8 ready!
notes.content:
Greetings and Salutations,

Eastwind Adventures Chapter 1 has now been updated to version 1.8!

The new update includes:

- Improved Health Bars

- New skills for Callie

- Improvements to the jungle in Callie's Story.

- Several bug fixes.

More updates to come!

notes.title: Big update!
notes.content:
Greetings and Salutations,

The new update for Eastwind Adventures Chapter 1 is now live!

The update includes a minimap for the main story, a new location for the main story, and movement effects such as footprints for all stories!

Also, several bugs have been fixed and systems streamlined.

More updates to come!

Best regards,

Fabian

notes.title: Day \ Night system fixes and more!
notes.content:
A new ending has been added to the main story, and improvements have been made to the day \ night system.

Work continues!

notes.title: Achievements, Day/Night system, and bug fixes!
notes.content:
Greetings and saluations!

Achievements should work now, and I have also added a day / night system, and removed quite a few bugs.

Work continues!

Best regards,

Fabian

notes.title: Busy with achievements and more!
notes.content:
I'm currently busy trying to get achievements up and running. Hopefully they will be ready some time next week.

Furthermore, a day \ night cycle for the main story is finished and will be part of the next update, which will come soon too!

Best regards,

Fabian
